notes.title: The first update
notes.content:
Hi guys!

The first update is ready, now you can pass the second level :)

1. Fixed the bug between 2nd and 3rd levels.
2. Notepad is localized. 
3. Replay menu is localized.
4. Intro now can be skipped.
5. Fixed some small bugs.

Have a nice play!

notes.title: Working on update
notes.content:
Hi guys!

I am very thankful for your reviews and reports. Negative feedback is useful for me very much :)
I know about a bug between levels when you try to enter the village. I am working with Steam Support because it seems something is wrong in my Steam SDK options (if it says anything to you ːsteamboredː).
Also I'm improving English localization and some other imperfections.

Soon there will be a huge update, I try to load it as soon as possible.

Thank you very much for interest and patience. I'm trying to do my best! ːsteamhappyː

I apologize for caused inconvenience!
Best regards,
Maria
